implemented: Append-only, hash-chained bounded research journal with a maximum of 256 variants per run.
Frozen mechanism source digest, seed, parameter catalogue and run timestamp.
Exactly one evaluated/failed/skipped/aborted outcome per declared variant; close requires complete accounting.
Bounded daily random search writes its complete variant results and records aborted outcomes on evaluator exceptions.
Restart recovery records ABORTED for pending variants left by a hard process stop before opening a new run.
Portable OS-backed sidecar locking serializes reads and mutations across processes; each operation reloads the hash chain and campaign ledger under lock before acting.
Research-only and auto-promotion-disabled flags are mandatory journal invariants.

tests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_research_library.py tests/test_bounded_search.py tests/test_strategy_variant_inventory.py -q; python -m ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/research_library.py tests/test_research_library.py; python -m mypy src/financial_brain/forward_edge/research_library.py
tests.result: Combined research-journal, bounded-search and strategy-inventory suite: 14 passed (exit code 0), including concurrent Windows process budget enforcement. Ruff and mypy pass for changed modules; source inventory and capability evidence refresh successfully.

limitations: The journal applies to the daily bounded search only; other search mechanisms are not yet wired to it.
The advisory sidecar lock protects only cooperating writers on filesystems that honor the operating-system locking primitive.
No full search on the owner's historical dataset or independent reproduction is claimed.
Research records do not establish a deployable edge or authorize strategy promotion.
